messages.text: For a Aerospace / Defense use case involving radar, where would Signaling / Non-signaling Tester fit in the test workflow?

### Short answer
The passages do not directly support placing a Signaling / Non-signaling Tester as the primary radar-target or radar-echo tester in an Aerospace / Defense radar workflow; CMX500-type signaling evidence is for LTE/NR/WLAN network emulation, device testing, OTA signaling, protocol/application/RF tests, and GPRF waveform generation/replay, not radar echo generation [1][3][40].  
【推論】In an Aerospace / Defense radar workflow, the supported fit would be adjacent to the radar system as a communications-link / waveform stimulus / protocol-test block, while radar echo or target simulation would require a radar-focused instrument such as an echo generator, because AREG800A is explicitly an Automotive Radar Echo Generator with dynamic artificial object generation and FMCW radar support [27][28].  
### Where it fits in the workflow
| Workflow stage | Fit of Signaling / Non-signaling Tester | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Communications subsystem test around the radar platform | A signaling tester such as CMX500 fits where the DUT needs LTE, NR FR1/FR2, NSA/SA, FDD/TDD, WLAN signaling, TX measurements, application tests, IP traffic analysis, or remote automation [1][3][49][52]. | CMX500 is described as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD device testing [1][3]. |
| OTA / antenna-system workflow when cellular or WLAN links are part of the system | CMX500 OBT fits in OTA signaling testing with antenna or multiprobe measurement systems for 5G NR, LTE, RedCap, WLAN, and Wi-Fi 7 contexts [19][22][83]. | MVG integrated CMX500 OBT into WaveStudio so MVG antenna or multiprobe systems can run 5G NR, LTE, RedCap, WLAN, and Wi‑Fi 7 OTA signaling testing [19][22][83]. |
| Non-signaling RF waveform stimulus / replay | CMX500 GPRF fits where the workflow needs ARB, CW, dual-tone, or replayed `.wv` waveforms for R&D waveform replay / creation and standalone TX measurement workflows [40]. | CMX500 GPRF Generator is described as a CMX500 non-signaling use case that generates ARB, CW, dual tone, or replay `.wv` waveform [40]. |
| Capturing and replaying IQ streams | CMX500 IQ recorder fits where the workflow needs to record IQ data, save `.wv` files, replay them, and use the same IQ stream plus RF parameters as signaling [42]. | The IQ recorder can record up to 4 Gbyte, save files as `.wv` for replay, and use the same IQ stream plus RF parameters as signaling [42]. |
| Radar echo / target simulation | The provided Signaling / Non-signaling Tester passages do not support this as the radar-echo test block; AREG800A is the passage-supported radar echo generator, with dynamic artificial object generation and FMCW radar support [27][28]. | AREG800A is specified as an Automotive Radar Echo Generator whose echo generator type is dynamic artificial object generation, with hybrid and digital concepts including FMCW radar support [27][28]. |
| Aerospace / Defense EME or susceptibility context involving radar exposure | The radar-related A&D workflow evidence is about RF susceptibility or electromagnetic-environment testing, where radar stations are external radiators and system-level EME tests evaluate effects under EM interference [10][13]. | DO-160 Section 20 says RF susceptibility covers conducted and radiated susceptibility and that emissions can come from external radiators such as radar stations [13]. |

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500 › mmWave extension 與 remote radio heads
[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 指出 3GPP FR2 frequency range 測試可由 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] 執行。Remote radio head 是獨立 compact unit，在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。CMX500 與 remote radio head 的 split concept 可在 5G NR FR2 frequency range 使用短 RF cable lengths，以最佳化 radiated chamber test environments 的 link budget。

適用 radiated chamber test environments：[[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。

R&S CMX500
[[R&S CMX500]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 Radio Communication Tester；依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] Specifications Version 11.00（August 2025），它是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]、NSA、SA、FDD、TDD、FR1/FR2 RF parametric testing、fading propagation conditions 與多種 OBT hardware configurations。

R&S CMP180
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 **Radio Communication Tester**，用於 production / wireless communication device 測試，依文件可配置多埠 RF generator/analyzer、通訊標準 measurement options、waveform options 與 [[R&S VSE]] 分析能力。

R&S CMP180 › 產品定位
[[R&S CMP180]] 是 Radio Communication Tester。依 [[CMP180 Features and Functions Version 09]]，文件涵蓋 global options、Bluetooth、CDMA2000、GSM、LP-IoT、LTE、NB-IoT、NR、spectrum analysis、UWB、WCDMA、WLAN、[[R&S VSE]] options 與 ordering information。

依 [[CMP180 Specifications Version 08.00]]，CMP180 支援 simultaneous receiver and transmitter testing，並提供 RF generator/analyzer no. 1 與可選 RF generator/analyzer no. 2 的多埠 RF 測試架構。

R&S CMP180 › Transmitter test functions
- 8 input signals to be multiplexed to RF analyzer no. 1。
- 8 input signals to be multiplexed to RF analyzer no. 2。
- frequency-dependent attenuation（FDA）tables for user-specific corrections，分別對 RF 1.1 to RF 1.8 與 RF 2.1 to RF 2.8。

CMX500 use-case based 5G testing › toolchain
來源列出的 CMX500 toolchain 包含：

- [[R&S CMsquares]]。
- [[R&S CONTEST]]。
- Conformance：LTE、NR、2G、3G、C-IoT。
- 測試範圍：RF Conformance、RRM、LBS、NetOp、PCT、signaling tests、application、callbox、NPT、PQA、3GPP RF preconformance、ATE。
- 相關設備：[[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S ATS CATR]]、[[R&S NGM200]]、[[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]。

- RF paths 已 calibration 時，system 需維持在 ±2 °C temperature range；否則需 recalibrate RF paths。

### Short answer
The passages do not directly support placing a Signaling / Non-signaling Tester as the primary radar-target or radar-echo tester in an Aerospace / Defense radar workflow; CMX500-type signaling evidence is for LTE/NR/WLAN network emulation, device testing, OTA signaling, protocol/application/RF tests, and GPRF waveform generation/replay, not radar echo generation [1][3][40].  
【推論】In an Aerospace / Defense radar workflow, the supported fit would be adjacent to the radar system as a communications-link / waveform stimulus / protocol-test block, while radar echo or target simulation would require a radar-focused instrument such as an echo generator, because AREG800A is explicitly an Automotive Radar Echo Generator with dynamic artificial object generation and FMCW radar support [27][28].  
### Where it fits in the workflow
| Workflow stage | Fit of Signaling / Non-signaling Tester | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Communications subsystem test around the radar platform | A signaling tester such as CMX500 fits where the DUT needs LTE, NR FR1/FR2, NSA/SA, FDD/TDD, WLAN signaling, TX measurements, application tests, IP traffic analysis, or remote automation [1][3][49][52]. | CMX500 is described as a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD, and TDD device testing [1][3]. |
| OTA / antenna-system workflow when cellular or WLAN links are part of the system | CMX500 OBT fits in OTA signaling testing with antenna or multiprobe measurement systems for 5G NR, LTE, RedCap, WLAN, and Wi-Fi 7 contexts [19][22][83]. | MVG integrated CMX500 OBT into WaveStudio so MVG antenna or multiprobe systems can run 5G NR, LTE, RedCap, WLAN, and Wi‑Fi 7 OTA signaling testing [19][22][83]. |
| Non-signaling RF waveform stimulus / replay | CMX500 GPRF fits where the workflow needs ARB, CW, dual-tone, or replayed `.wv` waveforms for R&D waveform replay / creation and standalone TX measurement workflows [40]. | CMX500 GPRF Generator is described as a CMX500 non-signaling use case that generates ARB, CW, dual tone, or replay `.wv` waveform [40]. |
| Capturing and replaying IQ streams | CMX500 IQ recorder fits where the workflow needs to record IQ data, save `.wv` files, replay them, and use the same IQ stream plus RF parameters as signaling [42]. | The IQ recorder can record up to 4 Gbyte, save files as `.wv` for replay, and use the same IQ stream plus RF parameters as signaling [42]. |
| Radar echo / target simulation | The provided Signaling / Non-signaling Tester passages do not support this as the radar-echo test block; AREG800A is the passage-supported radar echo generator, with dynamic artificial object generation and FMCW radar support [27][28]. | AREG800A is specified as an Automotive Radar Echo Generator whose echo generator type is dynamic artificial object generation, with hybrid and digital concepts including FMCW radar support [27][28]. |
| Aerospace / Defense EME or susceptibility context involving radar exposure | The radar-related A&D workflow evidence is about RF susceptibility or electromagnetic-environment testing, where radar stations are external radiators and system-level EME tests evaluate effects under EM interference [10][13]. | DO-160 Section 20 says RF susceptibility covers conducted and radiated susceptibility and that emissions can come from external radiators such as radar stations [13]. |

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › Section 20 — Radio Frequency Susceptibility
來源說此測試確保 EUT exposed to a level of RF modulated power 時不受影響，並分為：

- Conducted Susceptibility（low freq）。
- Radiated Susceptibility（high freq）。

來源說 emissions can come from equipment installed inside aircraft as well as external radiators such as radar stations；Conducted Susceptibility similar to [[CS114]] test，Radiated Susceptibility similar to [[RS103]]。

MVG OTA test systems now support full WLAN OTA signaling testing alongside cellular coverage with CMX500 OBT from Rohde & Schwarz › 重點摘要
- [[MVG]]（Microwave Vision Group）已將 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 的 full WLAN signaling test functionality，包括 [[Wi-Fi 7]]，整合進 [[WaveStudio Software Suite]]。
- 來源稱此整合讓 wireless and mobile device manufacturers 可在 single antenna measurement system 中執行 comprehensive 4G、5G 與 [[WLAN]] [[OTA testing]]。
- [[WaveStudio Software Suite]] 整合的是 [[R&S CMX500]] / [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 的 full Wi‑Fi（[[IEEE 802.11]] a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be）access point and station testing functionality。
- 來源明確新增：software now supports [[5G NR Non-Standalone]]（[[EN-DC]]）testing with the [[R&S CMX500]]。
- 來源稱這些擴充使 [[MVG]] multiprobe measurement systems 可在 single tester 內 fully support Wi‑Fi and cellular standards，包括 [[5G NR Standalone]]（SA）、[[5G NR Non-Standalone]]（EN-DC）、[[RedCap]] 與 [[LTE]]（FDD & TDD）。
- [[Pierre Jurek]] 以 [[MVG]] Deputy Chief Executive Officer 身分表示，整合 WLAN testing 與進一步擴充 cellular testing capabilities 是 significant milestone，讓客戶可用 one [[R&S CMX500]] signaling tester 在 [[MVG]] OTA test systems 中測試 all essential current transmission standards。
- [[Christoph Pointner]] 以 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] Senior Vice President of Mobile Radio Testers 身分表示，使用 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] in an [[MVG]] multiprobe OTA measurement system 的 manufacturers 可最大化 [[R&S CMX500]] extensive test functions，支援所有 WLAN standards including latest [[Wi-Fi 7]]，並支援 4G 與 5G mobile signals。
- 來源連回前一份合作背景新聞稿 [[MVG integrates CMX500 OBT into WaveStudio Software Suite, simplifying 5G OTA signaling test processes]]。
- [[MVG]] 公司背景段落與前一份來源一致：提供 electromagnetic waves visualization、antenna characterization、radar signature evaluation 與 electromagnetic measurements 方案；營運於 10 個國家；90% sales from exports；Group revenues exceeding €100 million。

R&S AREG800A › Echo generation
依 [[AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900]] Version 09.00（September 2025）：

- Echo generator type：`dynamic artificial object generation`。
- Echo generation concept：
  - `hybrid`：短物距 `< 17 m` 使用 analog stepped delay line；較長距離至 `3000 m` 使用 fully digital implementation。
  - `digital`：用於 [[FMCW radar]]；minimum generated distance 等於 radar under test 的 air gap value；maximum generated distance 為 `3000 m`。

AREG800A_specs_en_3609-8015-22_v0900 › 重點摘要
這份來源是 [[R&S AREG800A]] Automotive Radar Echo Generator 的 specifications，文件編號 `PD 3609.8015.22`，文件版本 `Version 09.00`，文件日期 `September 2025（LA）`，文件標題為 `AREG800A Automotive Radar Echo Generator`，Copyright `© 2021–2025 Rohde & Schwarz`。

[[R&S AREG800A]] 的 echo generator type 為 `dynamic artificial object generation`。Echo generation concept 分為：

- `hybrid`：短物距 `< 17 m` 使用 analog stepped delay line；較長距離至 `3000 m` 使用 fully digital implementation。
- `digital`：針對 [[FMCW radar]]；minimum generated distance 等於 radar under test 的 `air gap value`；maximum generated distance 為 `3000 m`。

產品資料適用條件（Version 09.00, September 2025）：

- 在環境溫度下儲存 3 小時後，進行 30 分鐘 warm-up operation。
- 符合指定 environmental conditions。
- 遵守 recommended calibration interval。
- 已執行所有適用的 internal automatic adjustments。

規格資料定義：

- `Specifications with limits`：代表保證的產品效能，以 `<`、`≤`、`>`、`≥`、`±`、maximum、minimum 等限制符號表示。
- `Non-traceable specifications with limits (n. trc.)`：依 specifications with limits 的方式指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的量測設備，Rohde & Schwarz 不保證。
- `Specifications without limits`：代表保證的產品效能，通常為 dimensions 或 setting parameter resolution 等無偏差或偏差可忽略的值。
- `Typical data (typ.)`、`Nominal values (nom.)`、`Measured values (meas.)` 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。
- `Uncertainties`：coverage factor 為 2，依據 GUM 計算，納入 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- `Data without tolerance limits is not binding`；文件 `subject to change`。

主要能力與限制：

CMX500 GPRF Generator
[[CMX500 GPRF Generator]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 中的 [[R&S CMX500]] non-signaling use case：在 CMX500 上產生 ARB、CW、dual tone 或 replay `.wv` waveform，支援 R&D waveform replay / creation 與 standalone TX measurement 工作流。

CMX500 GPRF Generator › IQ recorder
來源稱 IQ recorder 可：

- Record up to 4 Gbyte to a file。
- Save files as `.wv` for replay。
- Use the same IQ stream + RF parameters as signaling。
- As many instances as supported by CMX hardware。
- 2 per RFU。
- 1 per IFU。
- FR1 specialist：8 instances in parallel。
- Inspect the recorded trace directly in GUI。

R&S CMX500 › Application tests 與 audio
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

- 未啟用 R&S CMX-KA100 等 application test license 時，IP application test functionality 降到最低；只能使用 standalone mode，不能連接 external servers，也不支援 IP based measurements 或 tools。
- R&S CMX-KA100 提供 internal IP services 與 IP connection to DUT 測試 applications，包含 DNS、IMS、Message Center、FTP、HTTP、DNS monitor、IP logging、iPerf、Ping、throughput、Max Throughput Wizard、web server。
- R&S CMX-KA110 增強 KA100，加入 QoS、ePDG、N3IWF、delay measurement、IP tune tool、SMPP / MT SMS advanced settings。
- R&S CMX-KA150 提供 IP analysis tool，用於監控與分析 DUT uplink / downlink IP traffic。
- R&S CMX-KA180 提供 audio codecs for 4G and 5G IMS voice call，支援 AMR-NB、AMR-WB、EVS，並包含 [[R&S CMX-ZG180A]] external sound card drivers and configuration settings。
- R&S CMX-KA181 加入 [[POLQA]]，用於 measuring perceived speech quality；measurement version 為 3，mode 為 full-band 或 narrowband。
- R&S CMX-KA401 支援 WAV player / recorder、upload/download WAV files、file-based POLQA measurements 與 end-to-end audio delay。

R&S CMX500 › 使用介面與 automation
依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]：

| 介面 | 原文定位 |
|---|---|
| [[CMsquares]] | 單一 graphical user interface，web-based、responsive，支援 RF tests、functional tests、advanced signaling tests、protocol tests |
| [[R&S CMXmars]] | Message log analysis，可離線分析或在線監控 instrument messaging |
| [[R&S CMsequencer]] | Graphical scripting interface，可在 CMX500 或 Windows PC 上建立、設定與執行 test scripts |
| [[XLAPI]] | Python-based scripting interface，適合 complex scripting use cases |
| [[SCPI]] | Remote control interface，適合 simple、standardized scripting use cases |

XLAPI scripting environment：Python 3.10；script development computer 可為 Windows PC 或 CMX500；XLAPI installation package 為 **CMX-KF600X**。

MVG OTA test systems now support full WLAN OTA signaling testing alongside cellular coverage with CMX500 OBT from Rohde & Schwarz
這份來源是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 官網新聞稿，說明 [[MVG]] 已將 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 的 full WLAN signaling test functionality（含 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]]）整合進 [[WaveStudio Software Suite]]，使 [[MVG]] OTA test systems / multiprobe measurement systems 可在單一 antenna measurement system 內進行 4G、5G 與 WLAN OTA signaling testing。來源未標示發布日期與文件版次；raw frontmatter 的 created 為 2026-09-11。
